C-COMP-ID-001.bounded_by: Comparator mechanism is bounded; shared publishing/source-family concentration prevents treating it as independent outcome prediction.

B-POST-DIASPORA-MARRIAGE-001.transmission_channel: War displacement and diaspora networks reshape marriage-market geography, migration incentives and household strategies.
B-POST-DIASPORA-MARRIAGE-001.time_lag: Conflict period through postwar diaspora consolidation.
B-POST-DIASPORA-MARRIAGE-001.transportability: Mechanism-only; diaspora exposure cannot predict marriage outcomes for all Tamil households.
B-POST-DIASPORA-MARRIAGE-001.integration_action: Use as a bounded kinship/migration mechanism, not a population-wide marriage rule.

B-POST-CASTE-MILITANCY-001.transmission_channel: Militant governance and wartime authority can suppress or rework public caste practices without necessarily removing private/social hierarchy.
B-POST-CASTE-MILITANCY-001.time_lag: Civil-war governance period with uneven postwar persistence.
B-POST-CASTE-MILITANCY-001.scale: Z1 local institutions → Z2 conflict-region authority.
B-POST-CASTE-MILITANCY-001.transportability: Mechanism-only; effects vary by locality and institution.
B-POST-CASTE-MILITANCY-001.integration_action: Keep public-authority effects separate from claims of caste disappearance.

B-COMP-ID-LANGUAGE-001.transmission_channel: National-language choice reallocates symbolic inclusion and administrative access across linguistic groups.
B-COMP-ID-LANGUAGE-001.scale: Z2 national policy → Z1 education/administrative access.
B-COMP-ID-LANGUAGE-001.transportability: Comparator mechanism only; Indonesian outcomes are not predictions for Sri Lanka.
B-COMP-ID-LANGUAGE-001.integration_action: Use to test language-policy mechanisms while keeping institutional context explicit.

B-COMP-TN-JAFFNA-001.transmission_channel: Education, reservation/social policy and political mobilisation shape the conversion of human capital into occupational mobility.
B-COMP-TN-JAFFNA-001.time_lag: Generational, from schooling/policy change to labour-market outcomes.
B-COMP-TN-JAFFNA-001.scale: Z2 regional policy → Z1 household mobility.
B-COMP-TN-JAFFNA-001.transportability: Mechanism-only; Tamil Nadu cannot serve as a direct counterfactual for Jaffna.
B-COMP-TN-JAFFNA-001.integration_action: Compare mechanisms and denominators, not headline outcomes.

B-COMP-ID-LANGUAGE-002.transmission_channel: A non-majority lingua franca can reduce majority-language domination while preserving local-language use.
B-COMP-ID-LANGUAGE-002.scale: Z2 national institutions → Z1 everyday language practice.
B-COMP-ID-LANGUAGE-002.transportability: Mechanism-only; do not infer equivalent cohesion or growth outcomes.
B-COMP-ID-LANGUAGE-002.integration_action: Use as a bounded language-governance comparator.

B-POST-EDU-001.transmission_channel: Missionary schooling and English education build literacy/credential networks that can feed later professional opportunity.
B-POST-EDU-001.time_lag: Multi-generational, nineteenth century into post-independence labour markets.
B-POST-EDU-001.scale: Z1 schools/households → Z2 labour and administrative systems.
B-POST-EDU-001.transportability: Historical mechanism only; schooling advantage does not imply uniform household benefit or persistent dominance.
B-POST-EDU-001.integration_action: Connect education history to later opportunity while retaining access inequalities.

B-POST-LANG-NAM-001.transmission_channel: Official-language nationalism and decolonization politics interact with foreign-policy identity but operate through distinct institutions.
B-POST-LANG-NAM-001.scale: Z2 domestic policy ↔ Z3 international alignment.
B-POST-LANG-NAM-001.transportability: Sri Lanka-specific bridge; do not treat language policy as a sufficient cause of non-alignment.
B-POST-LANG-NAM-001.integration_action: Keep domestic language politics and NAM diplomacy causally distinct but historically connected.

B-POST-CASTE-ETHNIC-001.transmission_channel: Ethnic conflict can reorder political salience and public mobilisation while caste persists in social and institutional practices.
B-POST-CASTE-ETHNIC-001.scale: Z1 social hierarchy → Z2 ethnic political mobilisation.
B-POST-CASTE-ETHNIC-001.transportability: Mechanism-only; salience shifts are context-dependent and do not erase caste.
B-POST-CASTE-ETHNIC-001.integration_action: Represent caste/ethnicity as interacting hierarchies rather than a replacement sequence.

B-POST-WAR-HC-002.transmission_channel: War destruction, displacement and insecurity damage infrastructure and weaken the local conversion of human capital into employment/investment.
B-POST-WAR-HC-002.time_lag: Conflict years with persistent postwar recovery lag.
B-POST-WAR-HC-002.scale: Z1 local assets/households → Z2 regional economy.
B-POST-WAR-HC-002.transportability: Mechanism-only; war exposure does not uniquely determine regional development outcomes.
B-POST-WAR-HC-002.integration_action: Use as one mechanism in the Jaffna development trajectory, alongside policy and market-access factors.

B-POST-NAM-ECON-001.transmission_channel: Economic-decolonization agendas can connect non-aligned diplomacy to state-led trade, ownership and redistribution policies.
B-POST-NAM-ECON-001.time_lag: 1950s diplomatic formation to stronger 1970s economic programmes.
B-POST-NAM-ECON-001.scale: Z3 international coalition → Z2 domestic economic policy.
B-POST-NAM-ECON-001.transportability: Mechanism-only; NAM membership does not imply a fixed economic model.
B-POST-NAM-ECON-001.integration_action: Distinguish early diplomatic non-alignment from later NIEO/state-led economic agendas.

B-POST-001.transmission_channel: Heritage designation, tourism investment and urban redevelopment alter land-use incentives and representation of historical space.
B-POST-001.scale: Z0 heritage site → Z1 urban neighbourhood → Z2 governance.
B-POST-001.transportability: Mechanism-only; heritage status does not automatically produce displacement or gentrification.
B-POST-001.integration_action: Use as a bounded heritage-governance mechanism and preserve site-level evidence requirements.

B-POST-LANG-DEV-001.transmission_channel: Language policy changes access to administration, education and labour-market credentials, potentially redistributing opportunity.
B-POST-LANG-DEV-001.time_lag: Years to generations after policy change.
B-POST-LANG-DEV-001.scale: Z2 national policy → Z1 individual/household opportunity.
B-POST-LANG-DEV-001.transportability: Mechanism-only; do not infer aggregate growth effects from language policy alone.
B-POST-LANG-DEV-001.integration_action: Keep distributive access effects separate from macro-growth claims.

B-COMP-TN-TERRITORIAL-002.transmission_channel: Regional political autonomy plus infrastructure/social-policy investment can broaden access to markets and accumulation.
B-COMP-TN-TERRITORIAL-002.transportability: Comparator mechanism only; Tamil Nadu outcomes are not a direct counterfactual for Northern Sri Lanka.
B-COMP-TN-TERRITORIAL-002.integration_action: Use to isolate institutional/infrastructure mechanisms while foregrounding territorial and conflict confounders.
